desc:
🧱 Creative Build is a social building sandbox where your imagination becomes architecture!

*Private servers (VIP SERVERS) are free, and have a bigger building area!

🏗️ Place all kinds of blocks, furniture, outdoor décor, and interactive gadgets—mix styles to create anything from cozy homes to wild theme parks.
📦 Access your Build Inventory anytime.
💾 Everything autosaves. 
🎛️ Snap, rotate, color, and clone blocks.
🏠 Claim a personal plot and design rooms, gardens, castles and more.
👫 Build with friends—whitelist collaborators!
🌐 Cross-server saving keeps your items and builds safe everywhere.
🔧 Use interactive blocks (switches, sensors, lights, sounds) to bring your builds to life!

💎 Join our group for news & updates 💎
https://www.roblox.com/communities/502742426/OFFICIAL-WhyMe-Studio

⚠️ DISCLAIMER: This game is an original creation developed from scratch for the Roblox platform, featuring no copyrighted material.

Ready to build? Jump in and start your masterpiece! 🏗️✨
